u1d81f74e43: Programming MAC addresses and authentication codes
u897a382c94: ⟦1⟧Overwrite Bluetooth address⟦/1⟧ (覆盖蓝牙地址): when checked, each successful programming of a device consumes one MAC address.
ubf65a86b14: ⟦1⟧Force update authentication code⟦/1⟧ (强制更新认证码): when checked, each successful programming of a device consumes one authentication code.
u11111211a1: Core principle: as long as you make sure that each device is ultimately programmed successfully only once, the number of MAC addresses (or authentication codes) consumed corresponds exactly, one to one, to the number of successfully programmed devices. Programming failures do not affect the count: no matter how many times a device⟦1/⟧has failed before, it consumes only one MAC address or authentication code once it is finally programmed successfully.
u7e263c35c4: Normal programming scenario (programming with a fixture)
u49aae647f3: When programming with a fixture, the same board may be reprogrammed repeatedly, so to avoid consuming MAC addresses and authentication codes repeatedly, ⟦1⟧usually do not check⟦/1⟧ [Overwrite Bluetooth address] (覆盖蓝牙地址) and [Force update authentication code] (强制更新认证码).
u7003f5e6f0: When programming MAC addresses or authentication codes with the 1-to-8 programmer, make sure that ⟦1⟧the number of successfully programmed devices corresponds exactly, one to one, to the number of MAC addresses (or authentication codes) consumed⟦/1⟧. Use programmer version 3.1.33⟦2/⟧or later. The key points are as follows:
u29916f70c3: ⟦1⟧Successfully programmed devices⟦/1⟧: because [Overwrite Bluetooth address] (覆盖蓝牙地址) and [Force update authentication code] (强制更新认证码) are unchecked, programming them successfully again does not consume new MAC addresses or authentication codes.
u302c6a872a: ⟦1⟧Devices that fail programming⟦/1⟧: a device that still fails after several attempts must be ⟦2⟧marked immediately and removed from the current programmer⟦/2⟧. Do not leave it on the current programmer for further attempts, and do not plug it into another channel at random for programming,⟦3/⟧otherwise the number of devices will no longer match the number of MAC addresses/authentication codes.
u3325f5509e: Devices that failed programming should be ⟦1⟧collected and handled separately⟦/1⟧ in one of the following ways:
u0258fc6881: Redeploy the firmware (FW) to a new programmer and then program them;
ua216931eb1: Or handle them with a programmer that has completed the count for this batch.
ud6d910076b: When handling them, check the option that corresponds to what is being programmed:
ue4c8ba4964: Programming MAC addresses → check [Overwrite Bluetooth address] (覆盖蓝牙地址)
